summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Salt City participated in the installation of the Interact Club of Pawar Public School, Bhandup, for Rotary Year 2026–27.
description: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Salt City participated in the installation of the Interact Club of Pawar Public School, Bhandup, for Rotary Year 2026–27. The programme marked the induction of the new student leadership team and focused on youth leadership, responsibility, service and Rotary values. RCMSC President Rtn. Dr. Vinod Nair addressed the students and encouraged the young Interactors to lead with purpose and contribute meaningfully to their school and community.
